entries.title: Jeremiah 49:1
segments: ¶Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why [then] doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities? {Concerning: or, Against} {their king: or, Melcom}

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:2
segments: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the LORD.

words.text: , that I will cause an alarm
; and it shall be a desolate
unto them that were his heirs

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:3
segments: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, [and] his priests and his princes together. {their king: or, Melcom}

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:4
segments: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, [saying], Who shall come unto me? {thy...: or, thy valley floweth away}

words.text: unto me? {thy...: or, thy valley floweth away}

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:5
segments: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.

words.text: , from all those that be about
thee; and ye shall be driven out

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:6
segments: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:7
segments: ¶Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts; [Is] wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:8
segments: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time [that] I will visit him. {turn...: or, they are turned back}

words.text: him. {turn...: or, they are turned back}

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:9
segments: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave [some] gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough. {till...: Heb. their sufficiency}

words.text: to thee, would they not leave

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:10
segments: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he [is] not.

words.text: , and he shall not be able

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:11
segments: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve [them] alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:12
segments: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, they whose judgment [was] not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and [art] thou he [that] shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink [of it].

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:13
segments: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:14
segments: I have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, [saying], Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:15
segments: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, [and] despised among men.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:16
segments: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, [and] the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the LORD.

words.text: : though thou shouldest make thy nest

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:17
segments: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:18
segments: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour [cities] thereof, saith the LORD, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:19
segments: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who [is] a chosen [man, that] I may appoint over her? for who [is] like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who [is] that shepherd that will stand before me? {appoint me...: or, convent me in judgment?}

words.text: from her: and who [is] a chosen
over her? for who [is] like me? and who will appoint me the time
me? {appoint me...: or, convent me in judgment?}

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:20
segments: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.

words.text: : surely he shall make their habitations

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:21
segments: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea. {Red sea: Heb. Weedy sea}

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:22
segments: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:23
segments: ¶Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; [there is] sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet. {fainthearted: Heb. melted} {on...: or, as on the sea}

words.text: . {fainthearted: Heb. melted} {on...: or, as on the sea}

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:24
segments: Damascus is waxed feeble, [and] turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on [her]: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.

words.text: her, as a woman in travail

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:25
segments: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:26
segments: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:27
segments: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:28
segments: ¶Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:29
segments: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear [is] on every side.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:30
segments: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you. {get...: Heb. flit greatly}

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:31
segments: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars, [which] dwell alone. {wealthy: or, that is at ease}

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:32
segments: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them [that are] in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the LORD. {in...: Heb. cut off into corners, or, that have the corners of their hair polled}

words.text: . {in...: Heb. cut off into corners, or, that have the corners of their hair polled}

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:33
segments: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, [and] a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor [any] son of man dwell in it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:34
segments: ¶The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:35
segments: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:36
segments: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

words.text: ; and there shall be no nation

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:37
segments: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, [even] my fierce anger, saith the LORD; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:38
segments: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:39
segments: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, [that] I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.

words.text: But it shall come to pass in the latter
